name: s_air
js: const sb=window.sandbox; const r=sb.rider; r.pos.y += 110; r.vel.set(r.vel.x, 2, r.vel.z); r.state='freefall';

name: s_boost
js: const sb=window.sandbox; const r=sb.rider; sb.rider.respawn(r.pos.x, r.pos.z, sb.world.trapar.refAltitude()); r.pos.y += 40; r.vel.y = 3; r.state='freefall'; r.gauge=1; sb.scriptInput=(t,st)=>{st.boost=true; st.trim=0.5;};

name: s_pools
js: const sb=window.sandbox; sb.panel.applyStage('Streams + pools'); sb.world.update(sb.skyTime, sb.rider.pos);
